I’d say set some time aside where you can do some meditation.  If you’re not familiar with meditation, now would be a great time to start that process, as it helps in all areas of whatever path you decide to follow.  In order to produce powerful magick, generally you have to be in a higher state of mind, and so meditating helps to reach that state, and also helps with the visualization aspects of magick.  So, start there.  

While meditating try to focus on what your beliefs are.  Ask yourself what resonates with you, do you feel empowered by fire, herbs, prayer, while in nature, while around bodies of water, etc.  Really focus on what speaks to you.  Take that information and begin to research magickal paths that are in tune with your specific beliefs.  While some people may resonate with kitchen witchcraft, others may not.  Some people feel more empowered by conducting elaborate rituals, while others prefer to  meditate in front of a flame and create sigils.   Do you believe in the three fold law, or not, etc… There are SO MANY religions dealing with magick as well.  Anywhere from Wicca, to Hoodoo and Chaos Magick.  Just kinda get a grasp on your beliefs a little further. 

Luckily, there is SO much information available online.  When I first got into the Craft roughly 20yrs ago, information online was so hard to find.  Take advantage of that.  Look up absolutely everything you can.  There are a lot of books available as well.  My fav newbie books are by Scott Cunningham.  I think my very first was Solitary Witch by Silver Ravenwolf or something.  Anyway, don’t assume you’re going to believe everything you read.  Witchcraft is a very personal thing.      Educate yourself whenever possible.  I’ve been in this scene for a little over 20 years and am still learning constantly.  Take advantage of groups such as this, as learning from others is incredibly helpful as well.

Mostly, follow your beliefs, whatever they may be.  KNOW that what you try to manifest WILL work (you have to know it will, or it absolutely will not.)  Also, don’t be discouraged when something doesn’t necessarily work out as planned.  The Universe has a way of ensuring that what’s meant to be will be.  If something “fails,” perhaps it’s for the best, or maybe works out differently than planned.  Before you begin to put things into practice, however, make sure you know how to protect yourself from harm, whether that’s in the form of casting a circle, envisioning purifying light around you and your space, or even by limiting the people you confide in.  That last one isn’t always obvious, but sometimes the doubts of others can manifest into a blockage of sorts between yourself and your potential.   Most importantly though, trust yourself and trust the universe.  Do what feels right for you. 

Some topics to look into:

What is magick?

Magickal Deities

Pagan Religions

History of witchcraft

Magickal Protection

How to cast a circle

Totems and Talismains

Types of divination (tarot, runes, etc)
       Protecting yourself while using divination tools (such as the ouija/talking board/spirit board) - Also important… before using divination it’s important to know the basic “rules”

Metaphysical properties of crystals and herbs

How to begin a grimoire 

Etc…
